results.title: Karnali post 180 against Kathmandu after brisk start
results.content: Ariful Islam’s 22-ball 44 and Hussain Talat’s late innings push take the Yaks to a challenging total in Kirtipur.

results.title: Construction boom pushes Nepal’s mountain settlements into flood-prone areas
results.content: A new study finds at least 108,500 people in Nepal are exposed to potential flooding, as hydropower development, road expansion and unplanned urbanisation increase risks in vulnerable mountain regions.

results.title: Protest is not policy
results.content: Nepal’s protest has completed the first stage. The rest depends on what the country builds around it.

results.title: Indigenous climate activist Pema Wangmo Lama on flood recovery, loans and who gets to say no to hydropower
results.content: Lama, who recently attended the UN biodiversity talks, says post-disaster work in Nepal focuses on infrastructure rather than communities, and that safeguards for Indigenous people near hydropower projects rarely work in practice.

results.title: David Warner arrives in Nepal for Kathmandu Gorkhas’ NPL campaign
results.content: The former Australian opener could make his debut against Karnali Yaks in the first match of the day on Monday.

results.title: RSP weighs impeachment. What does it take to remove a Supreme Court justice in Nepal?
results.content: The ruling party has tasked its parliamentary wing with taking parliamentary action over alleged misconduct in the judiciary. But what does the impeachment process involve, and does the RSP have the numbers to see it through?

results.title: Govinda KC flown to Kathmandu as health deteriorates during hunger strike
results.content: Doctors say the medical education reform campaigner’s blood glucose level had fallen sharply, putting his life at risk.

results.title: Dashain gone, Tihar uncertain: Nepali workers stranded in Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks disrupt flights
results.content: Houthi attacks have disrupted nearly half of scheduled flights from Saudi airports, leaving migrant workers without clear information as their leave runs out and exit-re-entry permits near expiry.

results.title: Many children of Nepal’s Maoist war are done with politics
results.content: Two decades after the insurgency ended, the children of Nepal’s Maoist fighters are building careers in IT, fashion and insurance. A few still carry the cause.

results.title: Kathmandu Film Festival screening new titles and restored classics
results.content: The three-day festival features 38 films from 14 countries, alongside heritage events, masterclasses and discussions on the future of cinema.

results.title: Four Nepali Americans seek seats in three US state legislatures
results.content: The four Democratic candidates are running in Maryland, New Hampshire and New York in the November 3 midterm elections.

results.title: Bad weather disrupts flights at several airports; two international flights diverted
results.content: Bharatpur, Surkhet and Bhairahawa airports remain closed, while poor visibility and low cloud cover affect operations at Kathmandu airport.

results.title: Nepali players take the lead in NPL’s Player of the Match awards
results.content: After two seasons of an even split, Nepali cricketers have edged ahead of overseas players, winning 38 of the 70 awards handed out so far.
